children.text: Annotating Latino USA: Immigration, Policy, and Culture

In order to visually represent the LLILAS Benson's Latino USA Radio Collection, we used AVAnnotate to highlight areas of episodes focusing on immigration, cultural traditions of immigrants now in the United States, and international relations. In selecting the material to be included in our visualization, we focused on episodes that heavily feature talk of immigration and immigrant cultural traditions. We have also integrated a map identifying specific geographic regions mentioned throughout the episodes to understand how these places are represented and shaped by immigration discourses. This provides users with the opportunity to more easily navigate episodes based on geographic relevance while identifying broader patterns and trends in conversations about immigration.
